title: Fatty Liver Me Kaun Se Blood Test Karayein — Deoria
description: Fatty liver me kaun se blood test hote hain — SGPT, SGOT, lipid, sugar aur FIB-4 score, grade 1-2-3 ka matlab, aur Deoria me LFT ka sample ghar par kaise dein.
keywords: fatty liver me kaun sa test
fatty liver kaise theek hota hai
takeaways: Fatty liver aam taur par ultrasound me pakda jaata hai, blood test se nahi. Blood test ye batata hai ki liver par kitna asar hai aur saath me sugar-cholesterol kaisa hai.
Fatty liver me SGPT normal bhi aa sakta hai. Isliye 'LFT normal hai to liver theek hai' maan lena galat hai.
FIB-4 score — umar, SGOT, SGPT aur platelet se banta hai — batata hai ki liver me sakhti (fibrosis) ka khatra kam hai ya aage jaanch chahiye.
Fatty liver ka sabse pakka ilaaj wazan ka 7-10% kam hona, sharaab band karna aur sugar control hai. 6 mahine baad LFT dohraiye.

sections.heading: Fatty Liver Kya Hai — Aur Ye Itna Aam Kyun Ho Gaya
sections.lead: Pehle sharaab peene walon ki bimari maani jaati thi. Aaj zyadatar mareez sharaab nahi peete.
blocks: Liver me thodi charbi hona aam hai. Jab charbi liver ke vazan ke kareeb 5% se zyada ho jaaye, to use fatty liver kehte hain. Iski do badi wajah hain — sharaab, aur bina sharaab wali charbi jo motape, pet ki charbi, sugar aur badhe triglycerides se hota hai. Doosre ko ab MASLD (pehle NAFLD) kaha jaata hai, aur Bharat me vayaskon ka ek bada hissa isse prabhavit hai.

Deoria me bahut se logon ko iska pata tab chalta hai jab pet dard ya kisi aur kaaran se ultrasound hota hai, aur report me "fatty liver grade 1" likha aata hai. Zyadatar ko koi lakshan nahi hota. Yahi iski sabse badi dikkat hai — ye saalon tak chupke se badhta hai, aur kuch logon me liver me sakhti (fibrosis) aur aage chal kar cirrhosis tak pahunch sakta hai.

note.title: Ultrasound hamari service nahi hai
note.text: Liver ki charbi ki pehli pehchaan aam taur par ultrasound se hoti hai, aur sakhti naapne ke liye FibroScan jaisi machine se. MedicoBharat Deoria me sirf khoon aur peshab ke sample leta hai — ultrasound aur FibroScan hum nahi karte. Blood test ghar par kara lijiye aur report le kar ultrasound ke liye jaaiye.

sections.heading: SGPT Normal Hai Phir Bhi Fatty Liver? Haan, Ho Sakta Hai
sections.lead: LFT normal aana liver ke theek hone ki guarantee nahi.
blocks: Is bimari ke kaafi mareez ka SGPT range ke andar hi rehta hai. Aur kai labs ki upari seema itni upar hai ki halka badha SGPT bhi "normal" dikh jaata hai. Isliye ultrasound me liver me charbi aayi hai to sirf LFT normal dekh kar nishchint mat hoiye — sugar, lipid aur FIB-4 bhi dekhiye.

Ulta bhi sach hai: SGPT badha hai to har baar liver ki charbi nahi. Haal ka bukhar, kuch dawaiyan, sharaab, hepatitis, bhaari kasrat ya haal me hua peeliya bhi SGPT badhaate hain. Isliye ek report se nahi, kaaran dhoondh kar faisla hota hai.

sections.heading: FIB-4 Score — Blood Test Se Liver Ki Sakhti Ka Andaaza
sections.lead: Chaar number, ek formula — aur pata chalta hai ki aage machine wali jaanch chahiye ya nahi.
blocks: FIB-4 ek saada hisaab hai jo aapki LFT aur CBC report se hi ban jaata hai. Formula: (umar × SGOT) ÷ (platelet × √SGPT), jahan platelet hazaar me likha jaata hai (jaise 2.0 lakh = 200). Misaal: umar 50, SGOT 40, SGPT 50, platelet 2 lakh — (50 × 40) ÷ (200 × 7.07) = lagbhag 1.4.

Bina doctor ke liver ki 'detox' ya desi dawa se bachiye — kai jadi-booti khud liver ko nuksan pahunchaati hain.

sections.lead: Zyadatar liver ki charbi chup rehti hai. Ye lakshan chup nahi hain.

note.title: In par der mat kijiye
note.text: Aankhein ya peshab peela hona, pet me paani bharna ya pair sujna, khoon ki ulti ya kaale dast, bahut susti ya uljhan, aur bina koshish wazan girna — ye liver ki gambhir bimari ke lakshan ho sakte hain. Report ka intezaar kiye bina doctor ya aspataal jaaiye.

sections.heading: Purvanchal Ki Thaali, Chai Aur Liver — Rozmarra Me Kya Badlein
sections.lead: Liver ki charbi sirf tele khaane se nahi, meethe aur maide se bhi badhti hai.
blocks: Log sochte hain ki liver me charbi sirf ghee-tel se jamti hai. Asal me meetha — chai me cheeni, mithai, cold drink, packet ka juice — aur maida bhi utna hi zimmedaar hai, kyunki liver zyada cheeni ko charbi me badal kar jama karta hai. Din me 4-5 cup meethi chai aur shaam ka samosa-jalebi, saath me baithe rehne wala kaam, yahi aam kahani hai.

faqs.question: Fatty liver me kaun se blood test karane chahiye?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par LFT (SGPT, SGOT, GGT, bilirubin, albumin), CBC (platelet), fasting sugar aur HbA1c, lipid profile, HBsAg aur Anti-HCV, aur TSH. Fatty liver ki pehchaan ultrasound se hoti hai; blood test liver par asar aur saath ki bimariyaan batata hai.

faqs.question: Kya SGPT normal hone par bhi fatty liver ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Fatty liver ke kaafi mareez ka SGPT range ke andar rehta hai. Isliye ultrasound me fatty liver aaya ho to sugar, lipid aur FIB-4 score bhi dekhiye.

faqs.question: Fatty liver grade 1 kitna khatarnak hai?
faqs.answer: Grade 1 halki charbi hai aur aksar jeevan-shaili sudhaar se theek ho jaata hai. Lekin grade liver ki sakhti nahi batata. FIB-4 score aur sugar-cholesterol ki jaanch se tay hota hai ki aage kya chahiye.

faqs.question: FIB-4 score kya hai?
faqs.answer: FIB-4 umar, SGOT, SGPT aur platelet se bana ek hisaab hai jo liver me sakhti (fibrosis) ka andaaza deta hai. 1.3 se kam aam taur par kam khatra, 1.3-2.67 beech ka, aur 2.67 se zyada zyada khatra maana jaata hai. Ise doctor ke saath padhiye.

faqs.question: Fatty liver kaise theek hota hai?
faqs.answer: Wazan ka 7-10% kam hona, sharaab poori tarah band, meetha aur tala khaana kam, roz kasrat, aur sugar-cholesterol control. 3-6 mahine baad LFT dohra kar sudhaar dekhiye.

faqs.question: Deoria me fatty liver ka blood test ghar par ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, LFT, CBC, sugar aur lipid ka sample ghar par. Deoria Sadar, Rudrapur, Barhaj, Salempur, Bhatpar Rani, Gauri Bazar, Baitalpur, Lar aur Bhatni me. Ultrasound aur FibroScan hamari service nahi hain.
